decisions.reason: A particle therapy water phantom is a specialized, high-value niche system with long clinical product lifecycles, and its 2019 release makes withdrawal within a year unlikely despite the thinner web presence.
Small volume ionization chambers are core dosimetry consumables needed for small-field measurements, and certified medical devices like these typically stay in the catalogue for many years.
This second small volume chamber fills a complementary niche in the dosimetry portfolio, and re-certification costs discourage early removal.
A standard clinical ionization chamber is a staple product for reference dosimetry with steady demand from radiotherapy clinics.
Relative dosimetry chambers are routinely used with water phantoms and support system sales, so dropping it would weaken the product line.
Thimble chambers are widely used workhorse detectors with long lifecycles in the medical physics market.
